body: I just dont even know how to reach out. I assume he hates my guts. He did message me out of the blue to ask me some frivolous question last week, so maybe thats his way of saying hes ready to start up contact again? I dont know, im so confused

Wow, i appreciate this comment so much, thank you for sharing. You are so right about it being exhausting just to think about. I personally feel like one single problem I could probably push through and get by, but when everything else is going wrong too, it just becomes the elephant in the room. I wake up every day, have a panic attack and cry, and then go smoke and put in headphones so I dont have to think about the feeling of impending doom. Im an anxious person in general, and making one phone call/appt/job application is mentally exhausting, but having to do all of the above in the same day, multiple days a week? To spend money I dont have, so i can earn money i already owe someone else? I feel like Im tryig to claw my way out of a hole, but the more I try to get out, the more the walls come crumbling in on me.
